Package eu.algites.lib.action.interaction

Interface AIiActionInteractionCallerToProvider<E extends AIiActionInteractionEvent,F extends AIiActionInteractionFeatures,S,PM extends AIiActionInteractionProviderMessage<E,F,S>,CM extends AIiActionInteractionCallerMessage>

Type Parameters:
E - event type
F - supported features
S - interim state-result type
PM - provider snapshot type
CM - caller preference message type
public interface AIiActionInteractionCallerToProvider<E extends AIiActionInteractionEvent,F extends AIiActionInteractionFeatures,S,PM extends AIiActionInteractionProviderMessage<E,F,S>,CM extends AIiActionInteractionCallerMessage>
Direction exclusively exposed to the caller/controller. This interface MUST NOT extend the provider-to-caller interface; a caller cannot report provider progress or declare provider capabilities.
